notes: Shopify store, direct fetch worked (no WAF). Rule 1 applies hard here: shopifycolls' Shopify collections.json products_count field was inflated 1.4x-5.75x vs reality on every checked handle (e.g. decor-clocks metafield=23 vs 4 actual, bowl=53 vs 11 actual, plant-holder=21 vs 5 actual). Also many native collections (mirror/mirrors, lighting-candle, decor-decoratives) are tag-based and cross-contaminated with wrong product types (a 'Wall Art' item tagged into the Mirror collection; a wall-mounted bar unit product_type-labelled 'Mirror'; a transparent mug product_type-labelled 'Candle'; two lighting SKUs product_type-labelled 'Gift Set'; one lighting SKU labelled 'Plant & Lamp'). Given this, qty was NOT taken from any collection page - the full catalog was enumerated once via https://objectry.com/products.json?limit=250 (239 products, page 2 empty = confirmed complete single page, cross-checked against 'shopify' full-catalog enumeration of the 'all'/'shop-all' collections which gave 238-239), then every one of the 239 products was individually classified by title+product_type+body_html (fetched in the same JSON payload, no extra requests) into scope categories, correcting the mislabels above. EXCLUDED (not in scope, confirmed by title/body review): all Furniture (Table/tables/Chair/Sofa/Sofa Chair/Console/Cabinet/Bench/Stool/Desk/Shelf/shelf/Dining Table product_types, ~145 SKUs, incl. 3 mislabelled as 'shelf'/'Mirror'/'Cutlery' that are actually a chair, a sofa, a wall-mounted bar unit and kettle/salad-servers), Rug (textile), Handle+Hardware (cabinet/drawer hardware), Pen Stand + Desk Accessories + Stationery-tagged items (office supplies), Organiser/Hooks/Dustbin/Tissue Box (functional storage, not decor), Bottle Opener (bar tool), Cutlery/Salad Servers/Kettle (kitchen tools), Gift Option (donation add-on, not a product), 2 of 4 'Gift Set' SKUs that are mixed mug+stationery bundles, and 'Uneven Place Mats' (textile placemat despite being product_type-tagged 'Coaster'). Scented candles were excluded per scope's unscented-candles-only rule: 'Elephant Candle' (explicit fragrance text), 'Saturn Candle' ('ombre leather fragrance, soy wax'), and 'Ball Candles - Set of 2' ('fragrance tones: Spicy Mandarin...') all name a scent in body_html and were dropped; 'Ball Pillar Candles - Set of 3' and 'Step Candle Set' have no fragrance language and were kept as decorative unscented candles. Rule 0 applied: Furniture-department's 'Mirror' collection (handle 'mirrors') and Decor-department's 'Mirror' collection (handle 'mirror') are the same 4 physical mirror SKUs (Dot Square Mirror, Tube Mirror, Window Mirror, Uneven Mirror) cross-listed in both departments - counted once as Mirrors, not twice. No prior extraction of Objectry/objectry.com found anywhere in the scratchpad c*.json set -> not a duplicate company.
